photos.title: File:DFC 2960 Two women in traditional Thai outfits cook and serve food at a thatched market stall during an outdoor evening event.jpg
photos.description: The photo shows a food stall or small restaurant with a thatched roof overhang. Two people are wearing traditional saris - one in bright orange and the other in pink - and appear to be serving food at what looks like a food station or buffet setup. There's a menu board visible on the left side of the image. The setting appears to be an evening event or market, with some lighting visible in the background. Various food items and serving trays can be seen on the table in front of them. The atmosphere suggests this might be at a cultural festival, market, or special event featuring traditional cuisine.
